content: We are exploring ways to map informal lemmas in Physlib with experimental results in order to validate scientific reasoning. The goal would be to find connected and compatible set of lemmas that maximize prediction of experimental results. Have similar ideas been considered earlier?

I'm personally not aware of any work in this direction. I think related things have been discussed in the past, but not sure if anything came from them. If you are willing to share, I would be interested in hearing more details of what you have in mind? Sounds exciting :).
